# Tech Skills

AI skills that work with Claude Code and other AI agents. Each skill has its own folder, with its own `README.md`
and license.

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [DocPC](../DocPC/) | Builds assignment documents (proposals, reports, meeting minutes, filled forms) from source files: text scripts, draw.io diagrams, Word assembly and checks. Windows with Word and Excel only, for now. |
| [CTX-PLINE](../CTX-PLINE/) | Session memory for projects that works with any model in any tool: one Python script and plain files in the project. Setup: `CTX-PLINE/SETUP.md`. |

To install a skill, follow the `README.md` in its folder.
